$description: Semantic color tier. Raw HSL triples — consumers compose with `hsl(var(--token) / <alpha>)`. Values here ARE the Indigo / default theme runtime values (mesh-4 is green-teal to harmonize with pexels background, matching the themes/indigo.json override — repeated here so no [data-theme="indigo"] block is needed for users with no data-theme attr). Per-theme overrides live in themes/*.json. Two extra groups live here: `surface-glass*` (the consolidated window/popover material, replacing the six ad-hoc glass recipes) and `icon-*` (the dock's app-icon hues).

primary-glow.$description: Brighter primary used for glow gradients.

accent.$description: Accent color — cyan by default, green-teal on Dracula.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text. Asserted >=4.5:1 against both background and card for every theme by src/scripts/token-contrast.test.ts.

ring.$description: Focus ring; mirrors primary by default.

mesh-1.$description: Background mesh blob 1 — violet by default.

mesh-2.$description: Background mesh blob 2 — cyan by default.

mesh-3.$description: Background mesh blob 3 — magenta on Indigo (anchors the brand magenta). Green on Catppuccin/Tokyo-Night.

mesh-4.$description: Background mesh blob 4 — green-teal by default (harmonizes with pexels.background's 20% green family); replaces old violet-light emerald slot.

surface-glass.$description: Base material (.glass: bento cards, contact panel, CRT toggle). One owner for the whole recipe: colour + blur + saturate + border. Theme-aware via var(--card) -- the old hsl(230 30% 10% / 0.45) literal was blue-black in every theme.

surface-glass-elevated.$description: Raised material (.glass-strong: every WindowChrome, popover, spotlight, theme switcher, the Trayectoria cards). Three duplicated 230 30% 12% / 0.6 recipes collapse here.

icon-linkedin.$description: Dock app-icon hues. The defaults are the original hand-picked values; every non-default theme overrides them with a hue taken from its own palette (see themes/*.json), so changing theme repaints the dock. The terminal icon is not here: it maps to --accent, which is the same cyan in the default theme. There is deliberately no icon-github — the mark follows --foreground so it stays theme-aware.

shadow-glow.$description: Glow halo for primary / hero elements. Refreshed on every theme.

shadow-dock.$description: Dock container elevation (was an inline rgba literal).

neutral-tint.$description: Achromatic white. Exists so overlays, hairlines and grid lines can be written hsl(var(--neutral-tint) / <alpha>) instead of hand-written hsl(0 0% 100% / a) or hex literals.

gradient-text-from.$description: The .text-gradient recipe, tokenized so it can follow a theme (it was white to grey in every theme).
